title: E0 paper-profile checkpoint form A
instructions: Apply the reported English paper profile. Complete all three decisions without help.

parts.prompt: Which preparation map most accurately represents the currently reported English paper without turning provisional details into official rules?

options.text: One untimed paper containing grammar correction and a speech
A reported 90-minute objective section covering vocabulary, two cloze formats and reading, followed by a separately timed 30-minute composition
A 30-minute vocabulary paper followed by a 90-minute interview
Exactly five questions in every part because one candidate remembered that number

choice_rationales.A: Those tasks and the missing timing do not match the reported profile.
choice_rationales.B: This preserves the reported structure while avoiding unsupported question counts.
choice_rationales.C: The timings and task types are reversed and incomplete.
choice_rationales.D: A remembered count is not an official fixed rule.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The safe map records the supported section structure and keeps uncertain counts configurable.

parts.prompt: A story has 12 gaps and a box containing 17 words. Which method matches the reported banked-cloze demand?

options.text: Use every word, placing two words in some gaps
Ignore the story and match words only by spelling
Choose 12 words by grammar and whole-story meaning, leaving five distractors unused
Write new synonyms that do not appear in the box

choice_rationales.A: The surplus words are distractors, not extra answers.
choice_rationales.B: Grammar and coherence across the story are essential.
choice_rationales.C: This reproduces shared-bank selection with surplus options.
choice_rationales.D: Banked cloze requires choices from the supplied box.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Banked cloze uses a coherent subset of the supplied choices and leaves distractors unused.

parts.prompt: A candidate report mentions a composition of about 300 words, but no current official source confirms a strict limit. How should the course present this?

options.text: Use about 300 words as practice guidance and label strictness unconfirmed
Guarantee that exactly 300 words are compulsory

choice_rationales.A: This is useful preparation with an honest evidence boundary.
choice_rationales.B: The available evidence does not justify a strict claim.
choice_rationales.C: The composition component itself is supported.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Provisional details should guide practice without being presented as official rules.
